proves.claim: healthAdviceLines returns one line per recorded finding owned by this builder seat, from its title and next step, and nothing for another seat or role or an empty list.

cli.io-next-health.advice-lines.why: Without it advice meant for a builder would reach other seats or never be printed.

proves.claim: With health.adviceThroughNext off, healthAdviceLines returns no lines and never reads the findings.

cli.io-next-health.advice-off.why: Without it every next call would read the health findings even with the setting off.
